name: MonarchAiToolCall
title: AiToolCall
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.clickable header with expand and collapse semantics, androidx.compose.animation.AnimatedVisibility, MonarchStatusBadge for the state and MonarchAiCodeBlock for the input and output
summary: One tool call of an assistant turn as a card that opens: what was done in plain words, the state as a word in a status badge, how long it took and, on demand, the exact input and output.
whenToUse: For each tool-call part of an assistant message, when people should see what the assistant did; and in audit or debugging views where the raw arguments and results must be inspectable.
whenNotToUse: Not while the call waits for a decision: show an approval with MonarchAiPermissionScope instead. Not to show the result as a thing, such as a created record, which is MonarchAiToolResultCard.
api: @Composable public fun MonarchAiToolCall(part: MonarchAiToolCallPart, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, summary: String? = null, toolLabels: Map<String, String> = emptyMap(), expanded: Boolean? = null, onExpandedChange: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, announcesChanges: Boolean = true, maxValueLength: Int = MonarchAiToolCallTokens.DEFAULT_MAX_VALUE_LENGTH, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, stateIcon: (@Composable (MonarchAiToolCallState) -> Unit)? = null, toggleIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchAiToolCallLabels = MonarchAiToolCallLabels(), describeTool: ((MonarchAiToolCallPart) -> String?)? = null)

public class MonarchAiToolCallLabels(state: ((MonarchAiToolCallState) -> String?)? = null, formatDuration: ((millis: Long) -> String)? = null, input: String? = null, output: String? = null, error: String? = null, tool: String? = null, empty: String? = null, stateChanged: ((label: String, state: String) -> String)? = null, showMore: String? = null, truncated: ((shown: Int, total: Int) -> String)? = null, expanded: String? = null, collapsed: String? = null)

options.name: part
options.description: The call from the conversation model: name, input, state, output, error, start and end times, streamed input text.

options.name: summary
options.description: The one-line summary in words. Wins over describeTool.

options.name: toolLabels
options.description: Display names by tool name. Unlisted tools get a humanized name: search_documents is "Search documents".

options.name: expanded
options.description: Whether the details are open, when the app controls it. Kept inside, closed at first, when null.

options.name: onExpandedChange
options.description: Called with the new state when the header is activated.

options.name: announcesChanges
options.description: Whether a change of state is announced. Turn it off when the thread already announces it.

options.name: maxValueLength
options.description: The longest input or output shown before Show all, in characters. 0 shows everything.

options.name: icon
options.description: A decorative icon before the title in the AI tool color, such as a wrench. Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: stateIcon
options.description: A decorative icon inside the state badge for each state. The state is always a word too.

options.name: toggleIcon
options.description: An icon at the start of the header, such as a chevron pointing to the end; it turns a quarter turn while open.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the state names, the duration format, the headings, the empty and truncation notes, the announcement, Show all and the expanded and collapsed states.

options.name: describeTool
options.description: Builds the summary from the call. Return null to fall back to the tool's label.

states.name: running
states.description: Info tone and "Running". No duration until it ends.

states.name: succeeded
states.description: Success tone, "Done" and the duration, such as 0.4s, 12s or 2m 05s.

states.name: failed
states.description: Danger tone, "Failed", and the error under the card without opening it.

states.name: expanded
states.description: "Tool: <name>", then the input and the output in MonarchAiCodeBlocks named Input and Output, or "No details yet.".

states.name: truncated
states.description: A value longer than maxValueLength is cut at a line end when one is near, with "Showing 4,000 of 52,113 characters" and a Show all button.

appearance: A card on the subtle background with the subtle border and the medium radius; the icon uses the AI tool role, the state is a small MonarchStatusBadge in its tone, the duration and notes are muted caption text and the error is the strong danger role. Every color is a theme role, so it follows light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: Same parameters as iOS where Compose allows: isExpanded as a Binding becomes expanded with onExpandedChange, and the SF Symbol name systemImage becomes the icon slot, because Monarch for Android bundles no icons; stateIcon and toggleIcon are slots for the same reason, so without them the state is only a word in a tinted badge. The web uses <details>/<summary> and iOS a DisclosureGroup; Material 3 has no disclosure, and MonarchCollapsible takes only a text label, so the header is built with the same expand and collapse semantics as MonarchCollapsible. The web shows a spinner while running; Android shows the word, as iOS does. Values are pretty-printed with two-space indentation in the order of the object's members, as on the web (iOS sorts the keys). Times are ISO 8601 strings from the conversation model. The composable is experimental: an AI pattern that waits for a Rook app to adopt it.
accessibility: The header is one button read as the title, the state and the duration, with the state Expanded or Collapsed and the TalkBack expand and collapse actions.
The header is at least 48dp high; Show all is a MonarchButton with a 48dp target.
The state is always a word as well as a tone; the icon slots are decorative.
A change of state after the card appears is announced through a polite live region as "<tool>: <state>"; the first state is not announced, and announcesChanges turns announcements off.
The error line under a failed call is read as "Error: message".
The input and output are MonarchAiCodeBlocks named Input and Output, with a Copy button.
The title wraps and the state line moves under it at large font sizes.
edgeCases: A call without input and output shows "No details yet." when open.
While arguments stream, inputText stands in for a null or empty input.
A string that holds JSON is re-indented; text that only starts with a brace is shown as it is.
Times that cannot be read, or an end before the start, show no duration.
Show all is kept per block while the card is on screen; a new maxValueLength cuts again.

examples.title: Humanized summary with details
examples.template:
MonarchAiToolCall(
    part = MonarchAiToolCallPart(
        id = {{id}},
        name = {{name}},
        input = MonarchAiJSON.Object(
            mapOf(
                "query" to MonarchAiJSON.Text({{input.query}}),
                "limit" to MonarchAiJSON.Number({{input.limit|double}}),
            ),
        ),
        state = MonarchAiToolCallState.{{state|pascal}},
        output = MonarchAiJSON.Object(
            mapOf(
                "results" to MonarchAiJSON.Array(
                    listOf(
                        MonarchAiJSON.Object(
                            mapOf(
                                "title" to MonarchAiJSON.Text({{output.results.0.title}}),
                                "id" to MonarchAiJSON.Text({{output.results.0.id}}),
                            ),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
                "total" to MonarchAiJSON.Number({{output.total|double}}),
            ),
        ),
        startedAt = {{startedAt}},
        endedAt = {{endedAt}},
    ),
    summary = {{summary}},
    expanded = open,
    onExpandedChange = { open = it },
    icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Wrench, contentDescription = null) },
    stateIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Check, contentDescription = null) },
    toggleIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.ChevronRight, contentDescription = null) },
)
examples.code:
MonarchAiToolCall(
    part = MonarchAiToolCallPart(
        id = "call-1",
        name = "search_documents",
        input = MonarchAiJSON.Object(
            mapOf(
                "query" to MonarchAiJSON.Text("Q3 plan"),
                "limit" to MonarchAiJSON.Number(5.0),
            ),
        ),
        state = MonarchAiToolCallState.Succeeded,
        output = MonarchAiJSON.Object(
            mapOf(
                "results" to MonarchAiJSON.Array(
                    listOf(
                        MonarchAiJSON.Object(
                            mapOf(
                                "title" to MonarchAiJSON.Text("Q3 planning notes"),
                                "id" to MonarchAiJSON.Text("doc-18"),
                            ),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
                "total" to MonarchAiJSON.Number(1.0),
            ),
        ),
        startedAt = "2026-03-02T10:00:00.000Z",
        endedAt = "2026-03-02T10:00:01.400Z",
    ),
    summary = "Searched documents for “Q3 plan”",
    expanded = open,
    onExpandedChange = { open = it },
    icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Wrench, contentDescription = null) },
    stateIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Check, contentDescription = null) },
    toggleIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.ChevronRight, contentDescription = null) },
)

examples.title: A failed call, open
examples.code:
MonarchAiToolCall(
    part = MonarchAiToolCallPart(
        id = "call-2",
        name = "send_email",
        input = MonarchAiJSON.Object(mapOf("to" to MonarchAiJSON.Text("ada@example.com"))),
        state = MonarchAiToolCallState.Failed,
        error = "The mail server refused the message.",
    ),
    toolLabels = mapOf("send_email" to "Send an email"),
    expanded = expanded,
    onExpandedChange = { expanded = it },
)
